name: Alphadia III
description:
Before Alphadia I, the world was torn by the Energi War—fueled by humanity's lust for life energy. In the midst of it, an energi clone named Alfonso begins to question everything. With nothing but his doubts and determination, he sets off on a journey to uncover meaning in a world consumed by power. What truth awaits at the end of his path?

Alphadia III returns with deep turn-based combat, SP Skills to shift the tide of battle, and new mechanics like Arrays and the Energi Crock system. Upgrade your ship into a seaplane, trade Energi Elements, and dive into missions, arenas, and more—all wrapped in charming pixel graphics and a beautiful fantasy RPG adventure.



A time before Alphadia I—
As people sought the life energy known as "energi", their desires clashed, igniting the Energi War...
Amidst the chaos, there was an energi clone who questioned the war.
His name was Alfonso.
"Take action over worrying, believe in oneself and carve out your fate..."
What will he discover at the end of his long journey?


◆ Energi Crock

Put unused items in this crock during your journey to create Energi Elements.
Energi Elements can be exchanged for items at the exchange shop.

◆ Arrays

Utilizing different Arrays expands your strategic options.
Some Arrays have unique acquisition methods...?

◆ SP Skills

Filling the SP gauge allows you to unleash SP Skills.
These abilities will surely help turn the tide of battle.



Upgrade your ship into a seaplane during your journey!
It even has shops on board.

Includes classic features like missions and the arena!
Explore the vast world of Alphadia with beautiful pixel graphics!

requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: Windows 10 and up
Processor: Intel® Core™ i5
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: 4GB VRAM
Storage: 500 MB available space
Additional Notes: This app features keyboard controls and partial controller support with the Xbox controller. Mouse/touch screen are not supported.

Recommended:
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
